description: Wikipedia article summary (extract, short description, thumbnail image, canonical link) for a given title — CC BY-SA content, attribution included in every response. Parameters: ?title=<exact article title> (e.g. Bitcoin), ?lang=<language code> (default en). Costs $0.005 via x402 (USDC).

lang.description: Wikipedia language code (e.g. en, fr, de). Default: en.

title.description: Exact Wikipedia article title (case-sensitive for some words).

name: get_api_wiki_summary
